Your impact begins here

As Release Operations Manager, you will make sure every Novocare release reaches markets in a way that is consistent, scalable and compliant. You will lead the operational planning and rollout of Novocare V5 and ongoing releases across global markets, turning approved priorities into one clear, integrated plan. By keeping complex work visible and moving, you will help central teams, regions and affiliates launch with confidence, so Novocare support reaches each market reliably.

What you’ll bring

• A relevant degree in business, IT, engineering or project/programme management, or equivalent professional experience.

• Experience coordinating digital product or platform releases, multi-market rollouts or complex cross-functional programmes.

• The ability to manage integrated plans, dependencies, risks, readiness checks and stakeholder actions.

• A structured, dependable way of working that keeps complex work visible and moving.

• Clear communication and the ability to align teams without relying on line authority.

• A proactive, solution-oriented approach: you spot risks early, challenge stakeholders constructively when needed and escalate at the right time.

• A strong can-do mindset and a collaborative way of working.

Useful, but not essential:

• An understanding of product development processes and agile methodologies, including agile delivery.

• Familiarity with web/CMS or CRM environments.

• Experience in healthcare, pharma or another regulated industry.

What you’ll do

You will own the operational backbone of Novocare releases, from planning through launch, stabilisation and learning. Within approved priorities, you will own the operational plan, release calendar and readiness tracking, and you will recommend sequencing or a readiness hold when quality or market readiness is at risk.

• Own and continuously improve operational rollout procedures, so every market and release follows a consistent, scalable and compliant approach.

• Translate approved priorities into an integrated release plan with milestones, dependencies, readiness gates and rollout waves, and maintain the release calendar, dependency map, risk log and decision and action tracking.

• Facilitate planning and readiness reviews, confirming owners, evidence, actions and escalation paths.

• Coordinate rollout waves with Market Enablement and regional contacts, covering market readiness, localisation, training, communications, support and cutover.

• Track delivery, quality and adoption, and prepare governance updates and post-release reviews.

• Build clear operational structures and keep improving them with what each release teaches you.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Novocare within the newly established Consumer Care unit, reporting to Mathias Bauer Munk, Associate Director Novocare.

In PPS (Product & Portfolio Strategy), colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale.

Your remit is global. Working centrally, you will partner with Novocare leadership and capability leads; product, platform, content and GBS publishing teams; QA, Compliance, MLR, Privacy, Data and Consumer Care specialists; and delivery partners, Regional Market Enablers and affiliates. Your role is to bring everyone together around one plan, raise risks early and keep decisions moving. Some travel may be required.

What you can expect here

From day one, you will own a global rollout that connects functions, regions and partners. Clear priorities, honest feedback and fast decisions help the work move. Working with product, compliance, data and market teams, you will widen your perspective and build new skills on the job.

You will be trusted to make your voice heard, challenge constructively and help shape how Novocare releases are run, with support to grow as the platform and your role develop.

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level,  location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring structure, clarity and momentum to global Novocare releases, apply for the Release Operations Manager role by 29 October 2026.

For further information, please contact Mathias Bauer Munk, Associate Director Novocare at mbmk@novonordisk.com

_Do you enjoy turning complex process and operational data into meaningful improvements? And would you like to help build a more connected, data-driven way of monitoring and improving global processes?

_As our new Senior Specialist, Global Process Monitoring, you will help make the health of our global Order-to-Cash processes visible, measurable and actionable. You will work across functions and regions to identify systemic issues, uncover their root causes and ensure that sustainable improvements are implemented at the source, rather than repeatedly resolving the same symptoms.

**Your role

**Joining Global Operations Excellence, you will take ownership of global process monitoring, bringing together insights from local process-monitoring teams across our Distribution Centres.

Through regular end-to-end monitoring, you will transform process and ERP data into early warnings, actionable insights and clear improvement priorities. With a global overview of process performance and bottlenecks, you will help ensure that the right issues receive the right attention from Distribution Centres, Global Process Owners and other key stakeholders.

You will work closely with colleagues across Operations, Application Management, Master Data, Global Business Services, Data & Analytics, Digital & Technology and Finance. You will also help identify opportunities where analytics, data and AI-enabled capabilities can improve operational performance and create measurable business value.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own the global process-monitoring approach, incorporating insights from local teams across our Distribution Centres.

• Proactively identify issues and improvement opportunities throughout the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process.

• Turn process and ERP data into early warnings, root-cause insights and actionable recommendations.

• Govern and prioritise the global issue-resolution backlog together with Global Process Owners and Distribution Centres.

• Drive alignment across regions, Distribution Centres and global functions to support continuous process improvement.

• Identify opportunities for AI-enabled process optimisation.

• Build strong partnerships across Operations, Data & Analytics, and Digital & Technology.

• Support the adoption of increasingly data-driven and AI-enabled ways of working across Operation.

**What You Bring

**You combine a strong analytical mindset with the ability to influence, collaborate and create progress across functions. You are comfortable navigating complex processes and can translate data and operational insights into clear priorities and sustainable improvements.

**We Imagine That You Have

**

• Approximately three to five years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

• Experience within analytics, performance management, process improvement or operational excellence.

• A strong understanding of KPI frameworks, business-performance measurement and data-driven decision-making.

• Experience working across multiple operational functions, ideally within an international or global environment.

• The ability to influence stakeholders and establish alignment across teams and functions.

• An understanding of modern analytics, data governance and AI-enabled business capabilities.

• A bachelor’s degree within Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Analytics, Data Management or a related discipline.

• Experience working with reporting and analytics platforms, together with strong Microsoft Office skills.

• Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

**Your personal qualities

**You are curious, proactive and motivated by solving problems at their source. You approach challenges with a strategic and analytical mindset, while remaining collaborative and approachable in your work with others.

You communicate complex topics clearly, make considered decisions and maintain momentum across different stakeholder groups. Most importantly, you bring a continuous-improvement mindset and a genuine interest in how data, technology and AI can contribute to better business processes

Are you passionate about working with people and processes to connect functions, improve collaboration, and remove non-value-adding barriers across the development lifecycle?

We are looking for an experienced Process Partner to join the Product Creation Excellence (PCE) team and help maintain, govern, and continuously improve the process landscape for the development lifecycle at 3Shape. Working closely with the team and the wider organization, your goal will be to ensure that our development life cycle remains well anchored, aligned, and continuously improved, following best practices for efficient and predictable product and solution delivery.

At 3Shape, you will use your ability to align and influence stakeholders across organizational levels and functions, combined with your solid experience in end-to-end product development lifecycles covering software, hardware, and systems development—ideally within a regulated medical device environment.

You will join the PCE team, a group of around 10 colleagues based in Denmark, working to enable Product Creation and adjacent functions across processes, training, tools, strategy, and transformation.

Core Responsibilities

Lifecycle architecture & governance

• Ensure coherent, fit-for-purpose processes and process architecture for Product Creation by contributing best-practice insights and advising stakeholders at all levels on how to improve the process landscape.

• Drive and support continuous improvement of the process architecture and overall Product Development Lifecycle within Product Creation.

• Contribute to developing and maintaining the stage-gate model, continuous delivery approach**, and lifecycle governance structure**.

Process integration & alignment

• Drive alignment across processes, ensuring clear interfaces, effective handovers, and consistent ways of working.

• Align the development lifecycle across the value chain by establishing and maintaining suitable forums for process reviews and cross-functional retrospectives.

Process performance

• Define, anchor, and continuously review the process performance framework and related metrics.

• Drive recurring and structured root cause analysis to identify and address systemic improvement opportunities.

• Ensure processes enable improved performance by identifying inefficiencies and resolving structural issues.

Process anchoring

• Provide frameworks**, standards, and guardrails** for process owners.

• Inspire and challenge teams through best practices and external benchmarks.

• Facilitate cross-process improvement initiatives

Ideal profile

For this role, we are looking for someone who is passionate about relevant, optimized, and smooth-running processes. We imagine that you can check most of the following boxes:

• A strong team player who thrives on collaboration—both within the PCE team and across other teams and functions—to solve challenges and realize opportunities.

• Strong experience with end-to-end product development lifecycles and process landscapes or architecture, ideally across hardware, software, and agile development environments.

• A proven track record in flow optimization, Lean, or value stream thinking.

• The ability to influence senior stakeholders and work effectively across functions.

• Knowledge of medical device development or other regulated environments, including QMS design and efficient SOP architecture.

• Background in systems engineering, process architecture, or operational excellence

Experience from an internal strategy team, transformation office, or consultancy is an advantage.

Join us in shaping a company culture that makes Monday mornings worth it.

At 3Shape, you will join an international R&D environment in central Copenhagen, working closely with advanced hardware, software, and engineering teams developing products that help improve dental care globally. You will have the opportunity to shape how processes support engineering practice and see your work make a direct difference for colleagues across the organization.

We are a vibrant, visionary, and international workplace. Most of all, we are a diverse group of more than 50 nationalities, all contributing to a thriving company culture. We take part in social clubs, monthly social activities, and a variety of team events. If that is not enough, we also offer:

• Central Copenhagen location

• A globally recognized tech company with a strong international presence.

• An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• Daily breakfast and a delicious, healthy lunch prepared by our private chefs.

• A joint purpose: to enable dentists to provide superior dental care to every patient, every time.

Apply Now

Be part of a team helping to redefine treatment and care in a meaningful industry. We encourage all qualified professionals who are passionate about building high-performance medical solutions to apply.

Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we expect to conduct interviews in Oct.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity and believe that the best way to achieve outstanding business results is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**🟢 About Mapon

**35,000+ active clients. More than 400,000 connected devices. 150+ partners worldwide. And 200+ colleagues behind it all. Mapon has already built the scale, trust and reach of an established European B2B SaaS and telematics company, and we are still far from finished. Our platform helps businesses manage their vehicles, teams and assets, reduce costs, improve safety, simplify compliance and make smarter decisions. It delivers real value at scale and keeps evolving with the businesses that rely on it.

Those 200+ colleagues work across eight Mapon branches: Latvia, Spain, Estonia, Finland, Denmark, Lithuania, Sweden and Ireland, with our headquarters in Riga, Latvia. Our team reaches beyond those eight branches, bringing together people from even more countries. That mix of local market knowledge, international experience and different perspectives helps us grow one shared product across markets worldwide.

**✅ Why Join Mapon?

**Behind those numbers is a product that never stops improving and a team that keeps moving it forward. That gives Mapon a strong foundation for the next stage of growth: deeper relationships in the markets where we are already present, more businesses to reach and new opportunities to unlock. For Sales, it means a credible story to take to customers, backed by a platform that delivers real value and plenty of potential ahead.

**🇩🇰Working at Mapon Denmark

**At the Mapon Danish branch, you’ll join a local team of 9 colleagues, including 3 people in Sales team. You’ll have your closest teammates nearby, while also working with colleagues across our eight branches and beyond, sharing market insights and helping grow one product across different countries. It’s the best of both worlds: a strong local team and a genuinely international way of working.

**💻 Role Description

**As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll be the first point of contact for many of our future customers. You’ll reach out to companies across different industries to introduce Mapon’s fleet management and asset-tracking solutions. Your mission: generate high-quality leads, book meetings with potential clients, and support the Growth and Sales teams in growing our presence in the Danish market.

A typical week will include researching and identifying potential customers, reaching out through calls, emails and LinkedIn, following up on conversations and building new sales opportunities, giving you plenty of room to sharpen your B2B sales skills and take ownership of your results.

**Your first months at Mapon will be about getting to know our customers, our product, and what makes a great sales conversation, with regular feedback and support from the team. You’ll connect with businesses facing real, everyday fleet challenges and introduce solutions that can make a meaningful difference to their operations. It’s a chance to strengthen your B2B sales skills, take ownership of your results, and grow your career with an established international SaaS company.

**💼 What You’ll Do

**

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities in the Danish market

• Reach out to potential clients via cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn

• Qualify leads through discovery conversations

• Schedule and book meetings with potential clients for our Sales Manager

• Collaborate with the Growth team to refine messaging and outreach strategies

• Share feedback from prospects to help improve sales approaches and product positioning

• Maintain accurate CRM records and report activities

**✅ What We’re Looking For

**

• Native level Danish and excellent communication skills in English (spoken & written)

• At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer-facing roles (ideally B2B SaaS, but not mandatory)

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented mindset

• Curious and coachable — you’re eager to learn, take feedback well, and want to grow in sales

• Resilient — you’re not afraid of rejection and know how to bounce back with energy

• Tech-savvy and eager to learn new tools (CRM, sales engagement platforms, etc.)

**🌍 Why Mapon?

**💰 Base salary from 27 000 DKK/ Gross (monthly) **+ OTE bonus based on performance

**🌍 Join an international team of 200+ colleagues with global reach and local soul.

🍕 Partly subsided lunch at the office.

🧘♀️ Hybrid work setup – work from home or in a cozy office in Galten (mainly work is organized from the office).

🤖 Access to AI tools and paid plans, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and others if needed, to support your daily work and productivity.

🎉 Social events, team buildings, and a supportive work culture.

💼 Laptop, accessories, and everything you need.

🎂 Extra day off on your birthday.

🧠 Annual training budget.

🕓 Flexible hours to enjoy life outside work.

🪴 Wellness days- take time off when you’re not feeling well, without the need for a sick leave certificate;

🤝 Referral bonus — receive a reward when you refer a candidate who successfully joins our team;

🎓 Mentor bonus — onboarding mentors receive an additional salary bonus when their new colleague reaches the two-month milestone;

👥Join a friendly, supportive team where you'll thrive, with a well-planned onboarding process starting from day one to ensure your success.

**

•

As Associate Consumer Pricing Director, you will lead pricing and deal strategy for non-traditional channels across EUCAN: e-health and online channels, online pharmacies and e-commerce, direct-to-employer and private health insurance. Obesity is your primary focus. You will shape how deals are designed, negotiated and put into practice, while protecting the pricing system that supports access across markets. Your work helps more people living with serious chronic disease reach treatment, through routes that fit real life.

What you’ll bring

You combine pricing expertise with commercial understanding and the confidence to influence decisions at every level.

• An M.Sc. or MBA in economics, business administration, finance or a similar field.

• At least 7 years of experience in pharma pricing, market access, business analytics or finance, from an affiliate, regional or headquarter role, or from a consultancy.

• Proven expertise in international reference pricing (IRP) and parallel trade risk, HTA, launch planning, mature brand and generic life-cycle management, and budget  and forecasting processes.

• Strong project and stakeholder management, and strong interpersonal skills.

• Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate and influence across multiple levels, internally and externally.

• Business acumen and a problem-solving mindset that turns analysis into decisions that support patient access and business goals.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience negotiating commercial deals.

• Experience with e-commerce or digital health business models.

What you’ll do

You will be the recognised expert on commercial channel pricing in EUCAN, turning analysis into clear recommendations and deals that work in practice.

Lead commercial pricing and deal strategy for non-traditional channels

• Set the pricing strategy for e-health and online prescribers, online pharmacies and e-commerce, direct-to-employer and private health insurance across EUCAN, with obesity as the focus and the wider portfolio in view.

• Develop deal structures and pricing guardrails for non-traditional players, in alignment with IO Pricing.

• Lead gross-to-net and discount analytics to inform deal design and pricing decisions.

Lead the design, negotiation and governance of deals with key accounts

• Support affiliates in implementing agreed deals, from negotiation preparation and deal terms to follow-up.

• Develop and present recommendations to the EUCAN Pricing Council and to IO and HQ pricing teams.

Safeguard the core pricing system across the portfolio

• Assess and mitigate IRP and parallel trade risks arising from net prices in commercial channels.

• Monitor the online channel, competitor prices and the market access, HTA and pricing landscape across EUCAN, and flag risks and opportunities to your manager and the Pricing Council.

• Contribute to launch planning for new products, indications and formulations, and lead pricing life-cycle strategies for mature brands and generic and biosimilar insights, in coordination with Commercial.

• Support key processes, including annual budget planning and long-term forecasting, with recommendations, analytics and quality assurance.

Build pricing analytics, insights and capabilities

• Lead the development of commercial pricing capabilities, tools and best practices across the region and affiliates, and mentor colleagues in your field of expertise.

• Keep affiliates informed with timely communication, and share relevant best practices and information.

• Contribute to cross-functional team processes, including team meetings, budget and launch planning, and manage the budget for your own tasks and external projects.

Who you’ll work with

You will join EUCAN Pricing & Market Access in International Operations, where colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. Your responsibility covers the EUCAN region and your assigned therapy area(s), with specific countries managed as key accounts.

Your closest partners are the affiliates you support in negotiations and deal implementation, key account management, and Business Development. You will also work with IO and HQ pricing teams and present to the EUCAN Pricing Council, so decisions are made with clarity and at pace. You will report to Senior Director Pricing & Market Access

You will work in an international environment where your expertise shapes decisions across Europe and Canada.

The role offers real breadth with opportunities to work on Obesity and collaborate across the value chain and build new skills through regional and affiliate work. You will be trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard, supported to perform at your best in a team that combines curiosity, collaboration and ambition.

We value people who raise the bar, so clear expectations, honest feedback and the chance to lead smaller improvements are part of the everyday work. jobs.occupation: PhD Stipend in Experimental Quantum Materials Physics
jobs.description:
Join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production at Aalborg University and contribute to research on the quantum properties of matter at the scale of individual atoms and molecules. This is a full-time, fixed-term PhD stipend for three years, commencing on 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter

**Your work tasks

**The Department of Materials and Production is looking for a PhD candidate in experimental physics to investigate how molecular complexes can be used to engineer quantum properties in materials. The project addresses fundamental questions in quantum science while contributing knowledge that may support future applications within electronics, sensing and energy harvesting. You will become part of the Physics Group and work in an international research collaboration funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark.

Your research will focus on preparing and investigating molecular complexes on crystalline surfaces. You will deposit molecular complexes by electrospray techniques under ultra-high-vacuum conditions and study their structural and electronic properties using low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. The work will involve planning and conducting experiments, documenting methods and results, analysing and discussing data, and communicating findings clearly within the research collaboration and through relevant scientific channels. You will carry out a substantial part of the research independently while collaborating closely with researchers in the project.

Your competencies You hold a master's degree in physics, nanoscience or a closely related field. You have a solid experimental background within physics, surface science or nanoscience, together with documented experience in scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, ultra-high-vacuum techniques, cryogenic systems, surface science and electrospray deposition.

You can organise and conduct experimental research in a systematic manner, from the planning of measurements to the documentation, analysis and interpretation of results. You communicate methods and findings clearly in English, both in writing and in dialogue with other researchers. The position calls for a researcher who can take responsibility for their own work while contributing constructively to a collaborative and international research environment.

**Qualification requirements

**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are

You will join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production, where research activities explore materials and physical phenomena relevant to both fundamental science and future technologies. In this position, you will work at the intersection of molecular science, surface science and quantum materials research, with access to a research environment in which experimental methods and scientific discussion form the basis for developing new knowledge.

As part of an international collaboration, you will have the opportunity to engage with researchers across disciplines and contribute to a research project with both scientific depth and technological relevance. The position offers a strong foundation for further work in academic research, advanced experimental physics or research-intensive development environments.

**How to apply

**Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)

• Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment

**The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

**The Role

**Responsibilities

**

• Ensures alignment of SDTM standards with data collection standards and relevant company tools/system requirements by reviewing study eCRFs, supporting creation of external data collection standards, and providing SDTM mapping guidance

• Serves as a subject matter expert on all aspects of standards development that includes industry standards (CDISC), regulations, and processes

• Creates quality control processes, metrics and other measures to ensure compliance with standards

• Ensures work carried out in accordance with applicable SOP’s and working practices, as well as global agency regulations/guidance’s

• Creates any needed documentation and training for standard processes, change control management and tools

• Responsible for defining standards specifications working closely with implementation support teams (database set-up, completion guidelines, CRF designers, procedures, algorithm specifications and reporting requirements)

• Facilitates a culture of continuous process improvement and a high level of customer service by maintaining and improving the standards processes associated with standards creation, maintenance, decision-making and implementation

• Working with Digital Solutions and IT, support the implementation of future strategies and technology-enabled processes and tools for clinical trials standards, change control management and the exchange of standards information to internal downstream consumers and externally consumers

• Serves as a liaison between Clinical Programming and External Data Management to ensure data standardization alignment and proactively resolve external data issues that impact SDTM deliverables.

**Requirements

• At least 6-8 years relevant experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO or Regulatory Agency

• Proficient in SAS programming, 6-8 years experience.

• Practical knowledge and experience using R to support clinical trial preferred

• Demonstrated knowledge of clinical research, metadata management, industry standards (CDISC), FDA & ICH, GCP, and related regulatory requirements

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple tasks, complex projects and working with cross functional teams delivering to project and portfolio timelines and metrics

• Strong verbal and written communication skills; independent and effective working in a multi-study, multi-disciplinary atmosphere in a matrix environment

• Experience in clinical data management and/or trial management experience with technical expertise in standards management and implementation is preferred.
